payload.title: Protocol editor: an edit cannot clear optional columns (species, temperature adjustments, description) and the FCR-matrix editor is transposed against the backend contract
payload.rule_violated: A cleared field is cleared (null is a value, undefined is not) and the editor's matrix axes are the backend's: fcrValues[temperatureIndex][weightIndex]
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Source plus a live render: after '+ Add weight' the editor holds 5 rows x 4 columns and the server check 5 !== 4 rejects it; a square default grid is accepted and stored with its axes swapped. TypeORM skips undefined properties, so an emptied field never reaches the UPDATE. Fix: send null to clear (set speciesId and speciesName together) and transpose the editor; add a handler spec (none exists).
